title: 浸潤式微影製程
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究光學與液體、表面與液體介面、掃描與誤差、微影整合；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: optics and liquid, surface and liquid interfaces, scanning and error, lithographic integration. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.title: 比較解析度與焦深的縮放
steps.titleEn: Compare resolution and depth-of-focus scaling
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：提高 NA 通常使焦深更敏感。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Higher NA generally tightens depth-of-focus sensitivity.
steps.instruction:
比較解析度與焦深的縮放。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。用自訂並標明的假設資料做一個計算或分類例，保留單位、分母與中間結果。最後以「提高 NA 通常使焦深更敏感。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設波長、k₁、k₂ 都固定，只把 NA 從 1.00 改為 1.35。由 CD∝1/NA，CD 比值為 0.741；由 DOF∝1/NA²，焦深比值為 0.549。若原假想 CD=100 nm、DOF=200 nm，新值約為 74.1 nm、109.7 nm。這是相對縮放示例，不能視為特定掃描機的保證尺寸。
steps.instructionEn:
Compare resolution and depth-of-focus scaling. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Use explicitly hypothetical data for one calculation or classification; retain units, denominators and intermediate results. Finally check your inference against this principle: Higher NA generally tightens depth-of-focus sensitivity.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Hold wavelength, k₁ and k₂ fixed while changing NA from 1.00 to 1.35. CD∝1/NA gives a ratio of 0.741; DOF∝1/NA² gives 0.549. Hypothetical initial CD=100 nm and DOF=200 nm become approximately 74.1 nm and 109.7 nm. These are scaling examples, not scanner performance guarantees.
steps.observation:
提高 NA 通常使焦深更敏感。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
同時報告解析度改善與焦深縮小，不可只選前者。
steps.observationEn:
Higher NA generally tightens depth-of-focus sensitivity. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report both improved resolution and reduced depth of focus.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「浸潤只要把晶圓浸水即可。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。

steps.check:

本例驗收：同時報告解析度改善與焦深縮小，不可只選前者。

Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Compare resolution and depth-of-focus scaling", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Higher NA generally tightens depth-of-focus sensitivity." and retain one limitation.

steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Immersion simply requires submerging a wafer.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「列出折射率隨溫度變化的誤差鏈」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「熱穩定性會變成光學穩定性。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Trace temperature-dependent index into imaging error", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Thermal stability becomes optical stability." and retain one limitation.

knowledge.text: 浸潤提高晶圓側成像介質折射率，數值孔徑需依所定義空間計算。
knowledge.textEn: Immersion raises the wafer-side imaging-medium refractive index; NA must be defined in the appropriate optical space.

quiz.questionEn: After "Trace temperature-dependent index into imaging error", which interpretation is defensible?

頂層完全不影響光阻反應。
熱穩定性會變成光學穩定性。

The topcoat cannot affect resist behavior.
